justification: Changes the clause citations printed in the paid conveyancing PDF, the Brief, the granny flat report, the DCP controls card and the parking API, and changes a CHECK constraint plus a trigger on production tables. Critical: a wrong gate would silently remove or mis-attribute citations in customer reports.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls has no citation column (information_schema 2026-09-26); 843 served rows, 954 current rows with NULL provision_id. regulatory_provisions.citation_status from 076, constraint regulatory_provisions_citation_status_check.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed the page check judged a whole label. It judges only split_ref's sections + one item: on setback rows a label shifted by one still proved 60/115 (Table 1->2, Control 4->5, (1)->(2)). Also assumed setback source_text is verbatim: many rows are paraphrases, so 299 give text_not_found.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Additive column + trigger on dcp_setback_controls; constraint widened on regulatory_provisions. Reads unchanged except one added projected column via to_jsonb so code works before and after the migration.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A chapter PDF that cannot be read is no_source (hidden). State instruments (nsw_statewide, _external_*) are 'external' and shown as before, like LEP/SEPP rows in 076.
pre_impl.frontend_type: clause stays a string ("" when withheld); TS consumers map r.clause || null, so section_ref becomes null and the card shows the page. clause_shown is a new boolean.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If the writer never runs, citation_status is NULL and clauses are hidden with the page shown (visible as fewer clause numbers, never a wrong one). A consumer that borrowed the dict-level clause_ref for a row without a clause would cite ANOTHER control; served_source_ref prevents that.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: an unproven or unchecked setback clause is served, a withheld row borrows another row's clause, the granny flat report skips the gate, or a label with an unchecked piece is 'proven'
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 7 mutants (gate off in fetch_dcp_setbacks, borrow fallback, page fallback, granny gate, partial downgrade, external rule, label_of) each fail 1-7 tests. Known-wrong run on 843 live rows: shifted labels passed 60/115 before, 1/42 after.

functions.name: unjudged_pieces
functions.input: a clause label as stored, e.g. 'B7 5. Table 1' or 'Doc__chap__C4_9(a)'
functions.output: the pieces split_ref never judges (bare numbers, table/control numbers, bracketed sub-items)
functions.if_none: empty label -> the whole label is unjudged via split_ref's reason

functions.name: prove_label
functions.input: the clause label, the rule's own text, the chapter's page readings and the stored page
functions.output: prove_citation_any verdict, downgraded to 'partial' when a proven label carries unjudged pieces
functions.if_none: a failed verdict (not_proven, text_not_found, unjudged) is returned with its own reason unchanged

functions.name: judge_rows
functions.input: served setback rows (id, lga, chapter key, label, R2 path, text, page) and a loader for page readings
functions.output: a dict mapping each setback control id to exactly one verdict from STATUSES

functions.name: served_source_ref
functions.input: one entry dict from fetch_dcp_setbacks plus the dict-level clause_ref fallback string
functions.output: its clause, or its page when withheld, never the fallback for a withheld row
functions.if_none: when the withheld row has no stored page it returns 'See the plan', never the fallback

queries.where_clause: s.is_current AND needs_review not true; LEFT JOIN registry on council+chapter_key AND is_active (0 rows join >1 active registry row, measured)
UPDATE ... WHERE s.id = v.id AND s.is_current, 500 ids per statement, only changed verdicts
lga = %s AND is_current AND needs_review not true (unchanged); adds to_jsonb(...)->>'citation_status'

break_it.scenario: The new report code deploys to Railway before migration 077 is applied to the database
break_it.what_happens: a direct citation_status column reference would raise and fetch_dcp_setbacks returns None, dropping every setback from every report
break_it.how: the read uses to_jsonb(row)->>'citation_status', NULL when the column is absent; NULL fails closed to the page

break_it.scenario: A setback label is edited after it was proven (setback-review fix route, repair script)
break_it.what_happens: the old proven verdict would keep showing the new unchecked label
break_it.how: migration 077 trigger clears citation_status when section_ref, source_text, pdf_page or source_chapter_key change
break_it.repro: UPDATE dcp_setback_controls SET section_ref = section_ref || ' x' WHERE id = <id>; then SELECT citation_status -> NULL

break_it.scenario: The Brief or capacity maths reads a row whose clause was withheld
break_it.what_happens: source_ref fell back to dict-level clause_ref, the first OTHER row's clause
break_it.how: served_source_ref returns the row's page for a withheld clause

break_it.scenario: A label like 'B7 5. Table 1' is proven on B7 alone
break_it.what_happens: the reader sees Table 1 cited as the council's while Table 2 would pass too
break_it.how: prove_label returns partial when unjudged_pieces is non-empty; partial is not in either shown set

break_it.scenario: The verdict writer is run with a new status value the database constraint does not allow
break_it.what_happens: the UPDATE would fail mid-batch after earlier chunks committed, leaving a mix of old and new verdicts
break_it.how: plan_updates raises ValueError on any verdict outside STATUSES before the first write; STATUSES mirrors the 077 CHECK list and a test pins the shown set as a subset

post_merge.db_reset: Apply migrations/077 BEFORE merge, then run both status writers with --apply
post_merge.manual_verify: Generate a conveyancing report for a Georges River address: setback rows show 'Page N of the plan' in the Clause column where 6.1.2.3 Control N is not proven.
